findings.evidence: Positivity.lean:337-342 `have hexp : (1 + G) * crossSectionBracket M s x Q2 y F1 F2 F3 = x * (...)`, proved by one `linear_combination`; it uses only `hplus`, `hminus`, `hlong`, `hr2` — none of `hs`, `hy`, `hphys`, `hx`.
findings.fix: Extract as a standalone theorem `IsHelicityMatrixOf.one_add_targetMass_mul_crossSectionBracket_eq` taking only `h` and `hQ2`, and make `crossSectionBracket_nonneg` `rw` it.
findings.issue: `hexp`, the identity `(1+γ²) · crossSectionBracket = x · (A₊ σ₊ + A₋ σ₋ + 4(1-y-γ²y²/4) σ_L)`, is the central algebraic content of the file (module docstring line 49-50: "It is a non-negative combination of σ₊, σ₋ and σ_L"), but exists only as a `have` inside a 48-line proof; no user can cite it, e.g. for the saturating examples the PR says are still open.

findings.evidence: Positivity.lean:447-449 `have := hspec u hqu hTu` / `have : 0 ≤ W T T := hL` / `nlinarith [sq_nonneg b, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg b) this]`; Positivity.lean:172-174.
findings.fix: Name them: `have huu_le := hspec u hqu hTu`, drop `have : 0 ≤ W T T := hL` and pass `hL` directly to `nlinarith`; in `F1_nonneg` use `have hp := …`, `have hm := …`.
findings.issue: `have := hspec u hqu hTu` is immediately shadowed by `have : 0 ≤ W T T := hL`, so the closing `nlinarith` depends on an inaccessible hypothesis (`this✝ : g u u ≤ 0`); the second `have` is also a redundant restatement of `hL`. Same pattern in `F1_nonneg` (lines 172-173), where two anonymous `have :=` shadow each other and `positivity` silently relies on both via its hypothesis search.

summary: Three substantial, independently quotable facts — the bracket/cross-section identity, the kinematic domination inequality, and the orthogonal-splitting evaluation of W v v — are buried as `have`s inside two long proofs, so none is citable despite the module docstring advertising them. Also two places where an anonymous `have` is shadowed by a later one while the closing tactic silently depends on it.
